content: Yeesu na Melkisedek
Melkisedek yeem, a nikee buuraŋ Salem, a nammba nik seeƴkiɗohiŋ Kooh, yi ŋ ɗafka ɗafka. Wa Ibrahiima laɓ buur ca po a gurdeeɗa, a yi Melkisedek, a yi kee coha na ɗe, a yi barke'iɗ Ibrahiima ŋ cohaam.
Ɓaatta nga, Ibrahiima ɓayya ŋ in ca a naafee ŋ buur ca, a eɗta ɗe ndaŋkiyaah nu nik winooriŋ wa. Tiikiŋ Melkisedek, wa tokis buuri na tiindɗe waas. Te a nikee buuriŋ Salem, wa tokis buur jam.
Melkisedek nak ɓoo inhiɗɗi ɗe baab, ɓoo inhiɗɗi ɗe yaay wala caac. Te wa raakɗi ɗiski rimuukiŋ ɗe wala kakaan kiŋ ɗe fiisu. A mand na Yeesu Kuɓkiŋ Kooh, a seeƴkiɗoh po faw.
Markaat findi a yakoh, caaciŋ ɓoo Ibrahiima sah eɗiɗ ɗe ŋ in ca a kooɗohee ŋ hiñohaŋ ɗe na buur ca, ndaŋkiyaah nu nik winooriŋ wa.
Te waasiŋMusaa, wa nak ɓi ɓaah ŋ cuuɓiŋ Lewi, ɓi nikee seeƴkiɗoh ci, ne ɓeɗ rahsan ŋ ɓaah ciŋ ɓa Israayel ci, ngaŋ ini ɓa na raake, ndaŋkiyaah nu nik winooriŋ wa. Moona ɓa jen ɓa rimkoh ŋ Ibrahiima.
Waaye Melkisedek nak, ali a rimkohɗi nga ɓa, a rahsiɗ ineem ngaŋ Ibrahiima. Melkisedek barke'iɗta ɗe, te kat, Ibrahiima a yi nikee ɓoyi Kooh gape.
Wa raakɗi laam-laam, yi uup yak, a yi na barke'ɗe yi uup ƴin.
Seeƴkiɗoh ci rimkoh ŋ Lewi, ɓi na waɗse ndaŋkiyaah nu nik winooriŋ wa ngaŋ in ci ɓooɓi raak, mbeh na haye ɓa kaan, waaye Melkisedek nak, rahsiɗ waɗeem findiiɓa, te Fiis ci seede'iɗ ne a pesoh.
E ɓi ɓaah ngaŋ Lewi ɓeɗ na eɗse waɗeem, moona deey ɓo' miniɗ woo ne Lewi sah eɗiɗ Melkisedek waɗeem taamboh ŋ Ibrahiima.
A yi Lewi, raak ɗe rimuuɗi ndoom, a nikee ŋ ñif miŋ caac ɓa Ibrahiima, wa Melkisedek kaɗ coha na Ibrahiima.
Nikee ne pangkiŋ seeƴkiɗoh ciŋ cuuɓiŋ Lewi, wi waasiŋ Israayel ci gaƴkoh, mineen tum po ɓo' mit ɗah, mbaa wa heeɗi etohisse Seeƴkiɗoh wiiriis "findi Melkisedek", yi ɓaahɗi ŋ ɓi rimkoh ŋ Aaruna.
Kooh ɓoƴsoh findi seeƴkiɗoh ci na kooɗohse ɗah, e waasi ɓoƴsohu.
Laam, ɓoyi Fiis ci na woye ndii, a puloh ŋ cuuɓ wiiriis wi ɓaahɗi na wiŋ Lewi, te cuuɓeem, ali ɓo' moosɗi panguk nga findi seeƴkiɗoh.
Ɓooɓi jen inhiɗ ne Heɗ ɓoo Yeesu rimuk ŋ cuuɓiŋ Yudaa. Te Musaa, wi a na woye ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ seeƴkiɗoh ci, a wooɗi ali in ŋ cuuɓeem.
Wa ɓaatiɗ leer wi Seeƴkiɗoh wiiriis tufkiɗu, te findi Melkisedek,
a tumuuɗi seeƴkiɗoh ŋ nakohi kaɗ ŋ yi rimkoh ŋ cuuɓii wala ŋ cuuɓii, waaye a tumuuɗa ŋ doolndiŋ kipes ki minɗi reehɗu.
Laam Fiis ci woyiɗ inii nga ɗe :
Ŋ ɓak, nakoha maañɗa nihsuuɗ sagu raakaaɗiikiŋ wa hatil na njiriñ,
laam waasiŋ Musaa moosɗi mitiɗ ali in ; ŋ ɓak wiiriis, Kooh oniɗ ɓoo ini uupa, wi ɓoo min ooluk ne ɓoo taamboh nga, ɓoo reɓ ɗe.
Ɓaatta nga, ineem nikɗi in ƴin ; wa hunee na giñ ! Seeƴkiɗoh ci ɓinooɓi tufkiɗasseesa ɗah, wa na huneeɗi na giñ,
waaye wi ɓoyi Fiis cii na woye tufkiɗasse, Kooh giñ giñ ɗiski Fiis ci woo ne :

content.text: giñiɗ te a dokkanɗi finho nga,

content: E giñi tah po yi deguk ambtiɗohi uup baah, e Yeesu.
Te wa raakissiɗ in wiiriis : Weɗ ne seeƴkiɗoh ci ɓinooɓi laayiɗ sagu kakaan ki ; gomal nu gomal, yaa nu kaannda ɗah, morom ce namsiɗ ɗe, ineem weɗ hondoh ɓa nik seeƴkiɗoh po faw.
Waaye Yeesu, kipes kiŋ ɗe heyɗi reehe, weɗ tah a Seeƴkiɗohi moosanɗi namsiɗu.
Ineem weɗ tah a namiɗ min muciɗ muc mitiɗ ɓi taamboh nga ɗe ne ɓa reɓ ngaŋ Kooh. Laam, a pesan pes po faw ne a ngelɗee ɓa.
Yeesu a yi Seeƴkiɗohiŋ Ambtiɗohi Asi
Seeƴkiɗoh yakak mand ɗaa, a yi ɓoo etohee keeh-keeh, a hooliɗ, a raakɗi bakaaɗ, a raakɗi usuɓ, a saɓsohuuɗ na bakaaɗoh ci te Kooh meeɓiɗ ɗe po ŋ ɗafuk Eel ca.

A mandɗi na seeƴkiɗoh ci yakak ci ɓinooɓi ne mbeh nu nik, ɓa joyiɗ seeƴuk sagu bakaaɗ ciŋ ɓa haf ɓa, po ƴut, ɓa seeƴkis sagu caŋ ɓooɓa. Yeesu seeƴkiɗ waas yino po faw wi a eɗoh haf ce ne a hooliɗ bakaaɗ ci.
Seeƴkiɗoh ci yakak ci waasiŋ Musaa tufkiɗee, ɓa nikee seeƴkiɗoh mitaaɗi, waaye Seeƴkiɗohi yakki Kooh tufkiɗ na giñ, wi waasi eɗohu po ƴutta, e Kuɓkiŋ ɗe, te Kuɓkeem, a mitɗiɗ ɗe po faw.

footnotes.text: Heɗi : teerndiŋ Sabuur 110:4woo "Nikiɗi". Yawuut caŋ jamanoonaŋ Yeesu meeɗeen sang woo tiikeem ŋ ɗafka, sagu hooli wa hool.
